_notes.host: 0.0.0.0 = reachable over the network. Reach it over Tailscale, NOT a port forward, and never Funnel. The firewall rule deploy.ps1 makes is scoped to the tailnet (100.64.0.0/10). While no user exists the app ignores this and binds 127.0.0.1 so /setup can only be reached through an SSH tunnel.
_notes.auth_enabled: false is allowed only with host 127.0.0.1; the server refuses to start otherwise.
_notes.sync_times: local clock. SimpleFIN Bridge refreshes about once a day; three pulls is plenty and four is at the edge of what they call reasonable.
_notes.receipt_required_over_cents: business splits at or above this without an attachment show in Business > Missing receipts. $75 is the IRS documentary-evidence threshold.
